meta.label: RF-DETR + DINOv3 Defect Clustering
meta.description: Detect industrial defect instances with a provisioned RF-DETR checkpoint, embed them with frozen DINOv3 dense features, and organize them into review groups.
meta.author: Project contributors

params.name: models_separator
params.label: Provisioned model resources
params.description: The plugin never downloads model code or weights at recipe runtime. Paths must be readable by the DSS execution identity.

params.name: rfdetr_checkpoint_path
params.label: RF-DETR checkpoint path
params.description: Absolute path to the trusted, class-agnostic RF-DETR checkpoint.

params.name: rfdetr_checkpoint_sha256
params.label: Expected RF-DETR checkpoint SHA-256
params.description: Optional expected lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256. When supplied, a mismatch is fatal.

params.name: rfdetr_model_class
params.label: RF-DETR model class
params.description: Concrete exported rfdetr 1.5.2 detection variant qualified for this checkpoint, such as RFDETRSmall or RFDETRMedium. 'auto' is not supported.

params.name: rfdetr_package_compatibility
params.label: Required RF-DETR package version
params.description: Exact qualified production constraint. This release requires ==1.5.2.

params.name: dinov3_model_id
params.label: DINOv3 timm model ID
params.description: Qualified Hugging Face timm model identity. Runtime never resolves this ID over the network.

params.name: dinov3_timm_version
params.label: Qualified timm version
params.description: Exact installed timm version qualified by this plugin.

params.name: dinov3_artifact_path
params.label: Local DINOv3 artifact or snapshot path
params.description: Absolute path to an administrator-provisioned .safetensors file or offline snapshot directory containing exactly one top-level .safetensors file.

params.name: dinov3_artifact_revision
params.label: Immutable DINOv3 artifact revision
params.description: Immutable Hugging Face snapshot revision or administrator artifact revision recorded in provenance.

params.name: dinov3_artifact_sha256
params.label: Expected DINOv3 artifact SHA-256
params.description: Optional expected lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256. When supplied, a mismatch is fatal.

params.name: temporary_root
params.label: Local temporary root
params.description: Optional absolute directory for run-local staging. Leave empty to use the system temporary directory.
